title.narrative: Support to the Wolrd Customs Organization Programme Global Shield - strengthening control of chemical precursors for improvised explosive devices.

description.narrative: Project PGS GLOBAL aims at reinforcing WCO Programme Global Shield (PGS) at global level and is consequently looking for donor funds to re-establish global PGS outreach to all WCO Members in order to be able to better assist and prevent terrorist attacks caused by Improvised Explosive Devices (IED), mainly containing precursor chemicals.
